email.subject: Blue Pipe Works: quick fix for after-hours calls
email.body:
Hi Chloe,

I looked at Blue Pipe Works' site. Two things are likely costing you jobs: there's no way to book a visit online, so anyone searching after hours just calls the next plumber in Harbor Falls, and there are no reviews showing, which makes new customers hesitate before calling at all.

I fix local business sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd change first?

Alex
